# Linux

Stage variants cover ResolveProc, AcquirePath, ValidateFile, ReopenHeld, ReadFile, ReadProc, ParseMaps, ParseMounts, Calibrate, AssociateRange, AcquireProcess, SpawnChild, SignalChild, WaitChild, RetireMapping and Walk. Reason variants cover InvalidInput, NonRegular, Unreadable, Denied, Unavailable, Disappeared, ChangedSource, WrongContext, Malformed, Inconclusive, LimitExceeded(LimitKind), Allocation, Cancelled, Deadline, AlreadyWaited, IntegrationConflict and CleanupUnresolved.
